name: dsh-paranim
description: dsh-paranim（他化自在天 Paranimmita-vasavatti）: a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that runs an editable multi-agent town sandbox. Sidebar tabs register through ctx.betterSidebar; the host half owns the JSON sandbox store, a tick engine that drives every agent through ctx.llm on a per-agent model route, a D6 attribute adjudication engine (STR/CON/DEX/APP/INT/POW vs difficulty), a material-shaded canvas town map (tiles, roofs, roads, agent bubbles), right-click object state editing, user directives (神谕), and manual / auto-advance world steppers. Ships a recreated Stanford Smallville mirror as the default sandbox.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run selftest && npm run build
